scope: Independently published positions for Horizon-named Loop Current eddies; these are supplemental observations, not NASA individual-eddy identifications.

entries.name: Berek
entries.period: 2024 MASTR discussion; exact center date not stated in cited passage
entries.source_citation: DiMarco et al., Marine Technology Society Journal 59(3), 2025, Figure 3 discussion
entries.note: The authors locate the center of rotation of Eddy Berek near 26°N, 89°W. They also describe separation and reattachment from mid-2023 into early 2024. The coordinate is approximate and supplies neither a closed ring footprint nor a NASA model identity.

dated_map_presence.source_citation: Bower, Furey, and UGOS Scientific Team, 2024 annual meeting poster, Gulf of Mexico SSH map
dated_map_presence.note: The poster labels Eddy Berek on a satellite-derived sea-surface-height map dated 21 December 2023. Its map does not publish a numeric Berek center coordinate, a digitized closed contour, or a NASA ECCO identity.
